timing_notes: Frame distributions are wall-clock process-frame intervals. TIME_PROCESS includes GPU waits and is not pure CPU time.
GPU/render CPU fields are end-of-phase samples, not whole-run distributions.
Held route benchmarks retain live rendering/effects/HUD. Live benchmarks also retain physics and the production camera.
Only explicitly named frozen diagnostics stop all scene process groups and shader TIME.
Clocks were not locked; device performance and fan settings were unchanged.
The sampler-only diagnostic used the prior native engine, which always generated screen mips; the final APK includes the demand-driven engine fix.

native_patch.build_metadata_note: The build record baseline_engine_sha256 identifies the original engine-source-baseline.so snapshot, not the timing baseline. The measured baseline engine is builds.baseline.libraries[lib/arm64-v8a/libgodot_android.so].

staged_build_comparison.qa_override_note: Both builds use the same isolated Android export preset and validation.json autorun entry point. Neither is a production source change.

fixture_correction.reason: Godot ShaderCompiler excludes renderer-owned screen/depth samplers from editable uniform metadata. An inspection-only copy uses ordinary samplers to inspect preprocessed declarations; GPU draws and pixel comparisons always use the actual production shader. No image tolerances changed.
